page.layout: One block of text at the top, a dedication ending in italics and roman, with a line break at the end. Below it, a centred signature block of two lines and a name line. No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.p: & omnis Regiæ Virtutis semina foveas, augeas, & in fructum ma-turés, ut tibi Deus placatus & pro-pitius quod detraxit Patri Tuo felicitatis humanæ, Tibi adjiciat, & omnes illius ærumnas condu-plicatis in te beneficiis compenset, & appelleris Ille Restaurator, quem te unicè optant omnes & spe-rant futurum, & ardentissimis pre-cibus expetit
Majestatis Tuæ humillimus de-votissimusque subditus & facellanus

page.notes: Italic and roman boundaries in the dedication are approximate; the italic run is clear but some single words (e.g. "fructum", "maturés", "Regiæ") may be set differently and are not certain. "maturés" with an accent over the final e is doubtful. Long s in the signature and in "votissimusque" appears as a double-stroke form, transcribed as plain s. The name line ends with a mark that looks like a comma, transcribed as printed.
